title: Whacky Works
description: This Project Adds Whacky Blocks And Items
body:
This Mod Adds Cool Whacky Blocks And Items That I Decided to Add

I Highly Reccomend You Download The NeoForge Version As It Took Me Hours To Make The Helmet Mechanics

Currently Includes:
1.20.1 Forge (1.0.0): Guinness Potions And Everything That Comes With Potions (Tipped Arrows, etc.), A Suspicious Music Disc, An Asbestos Block And A Painting Of My YT Logo

1.21.1 NeoForge (2.0.0): Guinness Potions And Everything That Comes With Potions (Tipped Arrows, etc.), A Suspicious Music Disc, A Painting Of My YT Logo, An Asbestos Block, Asbestos Pieces And A Cool New Asbestos Helmet (Iron Tier Armour Stats) That Gives You Fire Resistance But Also Adds A New Hud Bar For Oxygen So You Only Get 2 Minutes Of Fire Resistance Before You Have To Take The Helmet Off (You Take Damage When Bar Becomes Empty)
